note: Related information is untranslated. Suggested Swedish: Relaterad information; Finnish: Lisätietoja. Native review of heading terminology.
hör jag gärna av dig is unidiomatic. Suggested ending: får du gärna höra av dig. Preserve Jennie's voice.
café utrymme should be a compound, e.g. kaféutrymme/caféutrymme. Do not otherwise standardize away Finland-Swedish wording such as drar kurser or Tyky-dag without Jennie's approval.
Tämän kurssin varaus on päättynyt can sound like a booking has ended. This means new bookings have closed. Suggested: Tälle kurssille ilmoittautuminen on päättynyt.
Fee is translated Hinta on the delivery fee chart. Maksu or Toimitusmaksu is more precise; choose against neighboring labels.

Ny egen beställning / Uusi oma tilaus suggests Jennie's own purchase rather than an order entered for a customer. Jennie should approve a label expressing a customer order entered by the florist; do not imply bespoke-only products.
Medel as a bouquet size is less natural than Mellan/Mellanstor. Jennie should select the canonical size name and align database-managed product sizes and previews.

Titles use keyword-like Floristiikkakurssit Vaasa / Hautajaiskukat Vaasa / Hääkukat Vaasa. Prefer natural Vaasassa if these are prose titles; a Finnish editor should choose florist-course terminology.

Embedded address remains Myrvägen 1 while standalone label and emails use Muurahaistie 1. Both name the same place. Official Minimossen Finnish site uses Muurahaistie 1; align Finnish copy without translating customer-entered addresses.

Literal wording makes a new card the agent that does or does not pay. Prefer wording explaining that saving/changing the card does not settle the existing unpaid order. Preserve the obligation to pay separately.
senast ... före en bukett / ... ennen kimppua is an awkward literal deadline. Specify delivery or pickup, preserving the days placeholder.

Description stretches the idea of making bouquets from the first message. Finnish lämpimiä ... kimppuja can imply physical warmth. Native editor should make warm-toned colors and end-to-end personal service explicit, if that is Jennie's intent.
syöttämällä se has an ambiguous antecedent after sähköpostiosoitteesi. Specify syöttämällä koodi rather than leaving se to imply the email address.
Subscription terminology shifts among kestotilaus, kukkatilaus and jatkuva kukkatilaus. Choose a consistent customer-facing term that distinguishes a subscription from a one-off flower order.

Wedding email subject/body switches between er/ni and du/din, and plural/formal Finnish and singular sinä. Could intentionally address a couple versus the sender; confirm with Jennie. Shared strings may need contextual variants, not a global pronoun replacement.

Consider natural wording for Oletko poissa, tai haluatko muutoksen?, Olen vastaanottanut maksusi %{amount}, and Seuraavat tilaukset ovat yllä olevaan hintaan. Preserve financial meaning, amount and date placeholders.

Name placeholder intentionally replaced by generic vastaanottaja, avoiding Finnish name inflection. Understandable and not an interpolation crash. Repo requires exact placeholders, so resolve with a grammatical name-preserving construction or an explicit developer-approved exception; do not blindly append case suffixes to arbitrary names.

recipient placeholder replaced with generic vastaanottaja. Linguistically defensible, but conflicts with repo placeholder policy. Prefer a natural construction retaining the name or document a deliberate exception.

These translations correctly describe the NEXT charge. English Charged / Charged to your card on is ambiguous. Change English to Will be charged / Your card will be charged on, rather than changing translations to past tense.

Confirm Jennie's authoritative wedding-price terminology: on request versus enligt offert/tarjouksen mukaan, and corsage or pocket square versus kavajblomma/taskukukka. English may need alignment with the actual floral product, not literal retranslating Swedish.

Finnish funeral introduction changes the Swedish idea of flowers as a restful focal point to saying farewell, and traditional arrangements to suruvihkot. Have a native Finnish florist/editor assess tone and scope against Jennie's approved Swedish, not English alone.

Pause or cancel anytime is translated faithfully, but the repo has a change deadline and already committed bouquets may still arrive. Coordinate English and translations; distinguish stopping future bouquets from cancelling the next bouquet.

Fulfillment is sometimes narrowed to leverans/toimitus although it includes pickup. Native editor and developer should choose labels covering both; do not change technical domain semantics in translation alone.
English distinguishes a placed order and confirmed booking; translations call both confirmed. Confirm natural terminology preserving that accepting an order/booking does not mean payment has arrived.
Receipt total label Total should preferably be Totalt or Summa; match other Swedish totals.
Gross is translated Totalt while Net is Netto. Consider Inkl. moms / Exkl. moms, matching the accounting report, or Brutto / Netto. Confirm with the accountant and native editor.
VAT and VAT rate use generic Vero / Verokanta. Prefer consistent ALV / ALV-kanta where the label specifically denotes value-added tax.

Delivery and Delivery fee use Kotiinkuljetus / Kotiinkuljetusmaksu, but orders also go to churches, chapels and other venues. Toimitus / Toimitusmaksu is more general and matches emails. Confirm receipt usage.
